payload.artist_html: Drawing by Michael Long, published by Christine M. Janis, Borja Figueirido, Larisa DeSantis, Stephan Lautenschlager
payload.description_html: Clovesuurdameredeor stephani (Hulke, 1877), comb. nov., NHMUK PV OR 49126, holotype. Skull in (A) dorsal, (B) ventral (palatal), (C) right and (D) left lateral views. Partial mandible in (E) dorsal view, and right retroarticular process in (F) dorsal and (G) right lateral views. Refer to abbreviations list. Scale bars: 10 cm (A–C) and 4 cm (E–F).
